shipped_rows.title_o: Reducing the Racial Achievement Gap: A Social-Psychological Intervention

blind_target.authors: Borman, G. D., Grigg, J., & Hanselman, P.
blind_target.title: An Effort to Close Achievement Gaps at Scale through Self-Affirmation.
blind_target.evidence_quote:
The current study was designed to replicate both the original self-affirmation study
(Cohen et al., 2006) and the previous successful independent replication (Borman et al., 2016).
blind_target.outcome_quote:
We found no evidence of
effects in this replication study and estimates were precise enough to reject benefits larger than
an effect size of 0.10. These null effects were significantly different from persistent benefits in
the prior study in the same setting, and extensive testing revealed that currently theorized
moderators of self-affirmation effects could not explain the difference.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The new cohort produced no benefits; the paper explicitly describes its failure to replicate. Previously reported cohort results are the comparison, not new successful replications.
